pages.text: Amphibia frogs carry genes in layers. Aptitudes are Power, Hardiness, Quickness, Cunning, Awareness, Temperament, Affinity, and Attunement. Phenotypes are Size, Coloration, Tongue Length, and Slime Yield. Ecology traits are Heat Tolerance and Humidity Tolerance. Each trait has two $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/alleles_and_carriers)alleles$(/l), so a frog can carry hidden value even when it does not look impressive yet.

Use the DNA overlay or Create goggles to inspect frogs and $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/frogspawn)frogspawn$(/l). Breeding is most rewarding when you keep an eye on $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/alleles_and_carriers)carriers$(/l), not only obvious winners.
